build_chat_input_token_ids: build chat input token ids from a list of messages using a model and tokenizer for Baichuan generation
create_text_iter_streamer: create a TextIterStreamer that decodes generated tokens into streaming text output from a tokenizer
use_text_iter_streamer_put: use the TextIterStreamer put method to feed generated token values into the streamer queue
use_text_iter_streamer_end: use the TextIterStreamer end method to signal completion by putting None into the text queue
iterate_text_iter_streamer: iterate over a TextIterStreamer instance to receive decoded text chunks as they are produced
